description: Inspect PDF, Office, and iWork documents without rendering: counts, metadata, security signals
name: io.github.deckflow/deckprobe

environmentVariables.description: Directories the server is allowed to read, separated like PATH. Unrestricted when unset.
environmentVariables.name: DECKPROBE_MCP_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Hard per-call deadline on an engine process, in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
environmentVariables.name: DECKPROBE_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum engine processes running at once. Defaults to 4.
environmentVariables.name: DECKPROBE_MCP_MAX_CONCURRENCY

environmentVariables.description: Maximum paths accepted by one probe_batch call. Defaults to 64.
environmentVariables.name: DECKPROBE_MCP_MAX_BATCH

environmentVariables.description: Path to a DeckProbe binary to use instead of the bundled one.
environmentVariables.name: DECKPROBE_MCP_BIN
